limits: Fixed AotR image, lit and shadow fixture on native D3D9 and installed DXVK; no gameplay FPS measurement.
Intervals partition producer wall time under worker contention, not CPU cycles or total GPU time. Direct publication includes replay; worker publication includes copying and waiting for a free slot.
Traversal includes native per-mesh control/events, palette copies and the first palette CommitChanges. It is not all removable overhead.
Profile probes add paired median 0.13-0.61 ms per pair across these workloads; retain uninstrumented comparisons and do not convert the profile into a promised speedup.

Original and command-specific fault regressions use DXVK; profile runs additionally validate both backends. Full plugin suite from dd4c0eb is not rerun because production and shared fixture support are unchanged.
next_experiment: Capture qualified follower palettes at the verified native group loop boundary, with original event/ownership accounting and fallback; compare complete native baseline, previous command worker and bulk-capture worker.
